lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: Hi Tom, do you have a minute? I need some help with the printer.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Sure. What's the problem?

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: It keeps showing a paper jam, but I can't find any paper inside.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That happens a lot. Try opening the back door and checking the roller.

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: Oh, I see it now. There's a small piece stuck there.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Great. If it happens again, call the maintenance team at extension 204.

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: Thanks, Tom. I really appreciate it.

title: First day at work
setting: A manager welcomes a new employee.

lines.speaker: Ms. Hoa
lines.text: Welcome to the team, Nam. How was your trip this morning?

lines.speaker: Nam
lines.text: Thank you. The traffic was heavy, but I arrived on time.

lines.speaker: Ms. Hoa
lines.text: Good. First, I'll show you your desk, and then we'll get your staff badge.

lines.speaker: Nam
lines.text: Will I have any training this week?

lines.speaker: Ms. Hoa
lines.text: Yes, the orientation starts at two o'clock in Room 3B.

lines.speaker: Nam
lines.text: Should I bring anything?

lines.speaker: Ms. Hoa
lines.text: Just a notebook. We'll give you the rest.

title: Weekly team meeting
setting: A team leader opens the meeting.

lines.speaker: Leader
lines.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's start. First item: the sales report.

lines.speaker: Mai
lines.text: Sales rose eight percent last month, mainly from online orders.

lines.speaker: Leader
lines.text: That's great news. Any problems we should discuss?

lines.speaker: Duc
lines.text: Yes. Some deliveries were late because our supplier was short of staff.

lines.speaker: Leader
lines.text: Could you contact another supplier as a backup?

lines.speaker: Duc
lines.text: Sure. I'll send you two options by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Leader
lines.text: Perfect. Let's move on to the next item: the summer event.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: I think we should spend more on TV advertising this year.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I see your point, but I'm not sure it's the best choice.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Why do you say that?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Our survey shows most young customers find us through social media.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: That's true. Maybe we can split the budget between the two.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: That sounds reasonable. Let's prepare a proposal for the director.

title: Requesting a deadline extension
setting: Read the email, then reply as the manager.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Dear Mr. Long, I am writing to ask if I could have two more days to finish the market report.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Some of the data from the Da Nang office arrived late, and I want to make sure the numbers are accurate.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I can send you a short summary by Friday and the full report on Tuesday. Best regards, Kim.

lines.speaker: Mr. Long
lines.text: Hi Kim, thank you for letting me know early. Tuesday is fine.

lines.speaker: Mr. Long
lines.text: Please include the Da Nang figures in a separate table. Best, Long.

title: Complaint and apology
setting: A customer writes, and customer service replies.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Hello, I ordered a blue office chair two weeks ago, but I received a black one.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Could you please exchange it as soon as possible? My order number is 5521.

lines.speaker: Service
lines.text: Dear customer, we are very sorry for the mistake with your order.

lines.speaker: Service
lines.text: A driver will pick up the black chair and deliver the blue one tomorrow afternoon.

lines.speaker: Service
lines.text: As an apology, we have added a ten percent discount to your next purchase.

title: Booking a meeting room
setting: A phone call to the reception desk.

lines.speaker: Reception
lines.text: Good afternoon, Star Business Center. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Hello, I'd like to book a meeting room for eight people next Monday.

lines.speaker: Reception
lines.text: Certainly. What time would you like it?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: From nine to eleven in the morning, please. Does the room have a projector?

lines.speaker: Reception
lines.text: Yes, all our rooms have a projector and free Wi-Fi. May I have your name?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: It's Minh Tran, from Blue Sky Travel.

lines.speaker: Reception
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. Tran. I'll send the confirmation to your email.

title: Leaving a message
setting: A caller cannot reach the person he wants.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Hello, Ms. Lan's office. This is Vy speaking.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Hi, this is Peter from Green Foods. Is Ms. Lan available?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: I'm sorry, she's in a meeting right now. Would you like to leave a message?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Yes, please. Could you tell her that the shipment will arrive one day late?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Of course. Does she have your phone number?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: I think so, but it's 0903 555 210, just in case.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Thank you, Peter. I'll give her the message as soon as she's free.
